newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen rebounding on China links.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen rebounding on China links.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were expected to open higher on Friday with investors hunting for bargains after Thursday's sharp losses, but the rebound would not be significant, brokers said.
Market focus would fall on shipping shares following China's approval on Thursday for six Taiwan shippers to commence direct sails across the Taiwan Strait, brokers said.

"Buying interest should be boosted by bargain-hunting and by the shipping news, but it will not be enough to change the cautious sentiment," said David Yu, vice president of International Investment Trust.
